g.title: NEEDS_ATT
g.text: attempt耗尽/DLT/卡死/饥饿/人工暂停

g.title: DISPATCHED->NEEDS_ATT
g.text: T9 无心跳 ∧ attempt 耗尽

g.title: RUNNING->SUCCEEDED
g.text: T10 G-4: 全 shard SUCCEEDED ∧ rowsOut+rowsDropped=rowsIn

g.title: PARTIAL->RETRYING
g.text: T17 attemptsLeft>0 仅重跑失败分片

g.title: RETRYING->NEEDS_ATT
g.text: T22 新 attempt 立即 FATAL
